providers.name: Groq
providers.freeTier: Groq documents a 'Free Plan' with per-model limits shown in your own console under Settings > Limits. The numbers are not quoted here because the public rate-limits page does not list them.
caveats: Limits are per organization and can change; check your console.
Reasoning models spend part of max_tokens on thinking.

providers.name: Google Gemini API (Google AI Studio)
providers.freeTier: The pricing page lists several models (for example Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite) as 'Free of charge' on the Free Tier. Exact request limits are shown in Google AI Studio, not on the public rate-limits page.
caveats: On the Free Tier the pricing page states content is used to improve Google's products; the paid tier states it is not. Do not send private data through a free key.
Available free models change; confirm on the pricing page.

providers.name: OpenRouter (':free' models)
providers.freeTier: Models whose id ends in ':free' are limited to 20 requests per minute, and 50 requests per day with fewer than 10 credits purchased (1000 per day at 10 or more), per the OpenRouter limits page.
caveats: Free models are shared and can be removed or rate-limited upstream without notice.
Prompts to free models may be logged by the upstream provider; check the model page.
